title: Stasis Atoll
description: A vibrant fantasy map illustration depicts a circular turquoise lagoon at the center of a floating atoll. Surrounding the water are distinct landmasses: a red East Asian temple platform with a pagoda and torii gate on the upper left, purple crystalline formations with glowing magenta crystals on the right, and a green overgrown industrial ruin with pipes and a large cylindrical structure on the lower right.
prompt: A detailed top-down fantasy map of a circular Stasis Atoll floating in the void, featuring a bright turquoise central lagoon with lily pads. Connected by stone pathways are a red East Asian temple platform with pagoda and torii gate, vibrant purple crystal clusters glowing with magenta energy, and a lush green overgrown industrial area with pipes and a large rusty cylinder. Small character figures and glowing effects are visible, in a colorful storybook illustration style on aged parchment.
